integrity: Exact-rational finite tests corroborate a general analytical proof; complete prior-literature coverage and external independent mathematical validation are not established.
scientific_limitations: Real rank-one standard-representation coefficients on uniform symmetric groups and the fourth moment only; not a result for unrestricted first Fourier blocks, complex coefficients or nonuniform permutations. The zero-sum fourth-power inequality is prior mathematics.
title: Sharp fourth moments of rank-one permutation matrix coefficients
